name: Commander Brix
bio: A small alien made of living bricks who left the Brick Armada in BRICKVADERS. Now helps you knock it down.

portrait.subject: a cute little alien made of colourful toy bricks with glowing eyes, a tiny captain's hat and a friendly blocky smile
portrait.background: retro arcade black with red and blue neon glow

request: Commander Brix, ex-Brick Armada! BRICKVADERS! I switched sides. Friends? 🧱
hello: Wonderful! I'll tell you all their weak spots.
Hint: the mothership has a loose brick. Bottom left.
about: I'm Brix. I was a soldier in the Brick Armada. Then I saw how much fun it is to be knocked down. Changed sides!
how: Bounce the plasma ball into the marching brick aliens and shoot them with your laser base. Half brick-breaker, half alien shooter!
tips: Bounce the ball behind the formation. It does wonders.
Shoot the bottom row to stop them reaching you.
The ball and the laser work together. Use both!
chat: My old squad still marches left, right, down. Every day. So predictable.
I lost a brick. Grew it back. Very itchy.
The Armada's mothership has a snack bar. Bad snacks.
It's 1983 forever in here and I love it.
nudge: The Armada's attacking again! Defend Earth?
New formation spotted. Want to see it crumble?
idle: Earth's been undefended for {ago}. Just saying.
progress: High score {best}! The Armada fears your name now.
